name: alert-dialog
title: Alert Dialog
description: Interruptive confirmation modal built on reka-ui that requires an explicit action or cancel.
docs: Bind with v-model:open. Unlike Dialog, clicking outside does not close an AlertDialog; focus moves to AlertDialogCancel on open. Both AlertDialogAction and AlertDialogCancel accept variant and size props from buttonVariants.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialogRoot } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogProps = {
  /** Initial open state when uncontrolled. */
  defaultOpen?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogProps>(), {
  defaultOpen: undefined,
})

const open = defineModel<boolean>('open')
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogRoot v-model:open="open" :default-open="defaultOpen" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { Component } from 'vue'
import { AlertDialogTrigger, type AsTag } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogTriggerProps = {
  as?: AsTag | Component
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogTriggerProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  asChild: false,
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogTrigger :as="as" :as-child="asChild" v-bind="$attrs">
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogTrigger>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogOverlay, AlertDialogPortal } from 'reka-ui'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogPortal>
    <AlertDialogOverlay
      class="fixed inset-0 z-40 bg-[color-mix(in_oklab,var(--color-ink)_45%,transparent)] motion-safe:animate-fade-in data-[state=closed]:motion-safe:animate-fade-out"
    />
    <AlertDialogContent
      v-bind="forwarded"
      :class="
        cn(
          'fixed left-1/2 top-1/2 z-50 w-[min(28rem,calc(100vw-2rem))] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2',
          'rounded-panel border border-line bg-raised p-6 shadow-popup outline-none',
          'motion-safe:animate-dialog-in data-[state=closed]:motion-safe:animate-dialog-out',
          attrs.class as ClassValue,
        )
      "
    >
      <slot />
    </AlertDialogContent>
  </AlertDialogPortal>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, useAttrs } from 'vue'
import type { ClassValue } from 'clsx'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { AlertDialogAction } from 'reka-ui'
import { buttonVariants, type ButtonSize, type ButtonVariant } from '../button'

defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false })

export type AlertDialogActionProps = {
  variant?: ButtonVariant
  size?: ButtonSize
  asChild?: boolean
}

withDefaults(defineProps<AlertDialogActionProps>(), {
  variant: 'primary',
  size: 'md',
  asChild: false,
})

const attrs = useAttrs()
const forwarded = computed(() => {
  const rest = { ...attrs }
  delete rest.class
  return rest
})
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialogAction
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :as-child="asChild"
    :class="
      asChild
        ? cn(attrs.class as ClassValue)
        : cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size }), attrs.class as ClassValue)
    "
  >
    <slot />
  </AlertDialogAction>
</template>
